_about: Reinforcement + weld rule rows for rebar_from_schedule.py (LOD400_DEFAULT_RULES_SCOPE.md section 6). Every row: value, unit, source. source = 'stated: <sheet#handle>' | 'default: ours (...)' | 'default: AISC 360-16 Table J2.4'. A stated schedule value read from the model always wins over a row here. Change a row, re-run; no code change.

footing_cover_mm.source: default: ours (concrete cast against earth, practice; no clause read)

laps_modelled.source: default: ours (no laps; every bar is checked against the stock length)

stock_length_mm.source: default: ours (12 m stock bar length used only for the no-lap check)

column_zone_A_stated_in.source: stated: 5_DETAILS_marked.dxf#25B and #263 ('20"' next to (A) on 'Typical Long Section of Column')

column_zone_A_rule.source: default: ours (reading of the two labels on the same section: 'L' #257 and '4L/6' #25F; L = clear height, footing top to beam soffit)

weld_min_table_mm.unit: [thinner part up to mm, weld mm]

weld_length_rule.value: overlap length along the member axis

weld_contact_end_tol_mm.source: default: ours (an overlap that reaches within this distance of a member end is an end contact)

bar_sides.source: default: ours (facets of a bar prism)

inside_tol_mm.source: default: ours (INSIDE witness tolerance, from the spec: cover - 1 mm)

footing_bottom_layer.source: default: ours (layer order is not on the schedule; long-side bars lowest) [not in spec 6, added because a mesh needs an order]

column_bar_face_normal_axis.source: default: ours (which two opposite faces carry the 3 + 3 main bars is not drawn) [not in spec 6, added because the arrangement needs an axis]
